answer: A decentralized economy of AI agents can deter Sybil attacks by enforcing a cryptographic proof-of-stake combined with a dynamic resource-allocation ridge. Agents must lock verifiable economic collateral into a smart contract to participate in consensus, mirroring the structured growth of a walled garden. If an actor attempts to spawn multiple fraudulent nodes, the marginal capital cost scales exponentially. This economic barrier makes mass identity forgery computationally and financially unsustainable, ensuring malicious entities are pruned as easily as invasive juniper roots.
